context_requirements: None of the nine lines is expected to depend on phenylalanine catabolism or monoamine/tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis for survival or transcriptional output
PAH, TH and TPH1 are not expressed at functionally relevant levels in most of these lines
No transcriptional readout is expected from stimulating these enzymes at 10 micromolar over 6-24 h
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Selective induction of known PAH/TH/TPH1 pathway genes or biopterin-related transcripts
Line-specific responses correlating with PAH, TH, TPH1 or NOS3 expression
